Company profile

An established Indian manufacturer, now looking outward.

With over 20 years of experience in footwear manufacturing, we are an established Indian manufacturer specialising in lightweight rubber and EVA flip-flops, with a strong focus on quality, comfort, durability and competitive pricing.

We manufacture a wide range of flip-flops, widely known as hawai in India, thongs in Australia and jandals in New Zealand. Our products are designed to serve both value and quality-conscious markets, with offerings typically ranging from US$1 to US$10 depending on construction, materials, design and specification.

Over the years we have developed strong manufacturing capabilities and experience in serving the requirements of established footwear brands through OEM and private-label manufacturing, including Indian brands such as Paragon and Lakhani.

Our strength lies in our understanding of footwear materials, production processes, moulding, finishing, quality control and large-scale repeat production. Consistent quality, competitive pricing, reliable production, customisation and long-term partnerships are how we work.
